दैशिक a. (की f.) [देशेन निर्वृत्तं
तस्येदं वा-ठञ्]
1 Local, provincial.
--2 National, belonging to the whole
country.
--3 Belonging or having
reference to space; Bhāṣā

.
--4 Acquainted with any place.
--5
Teaching, pointing, directing,
showing.
--कः
1 A teacher, preceptor.
--2
A guide.

दैष्टिक a. (की f.) [दिष्टमिति
मतिर्यस्य, ठक्] Fated, predestined.
--कः
A fatalist.
